nodes.label: TUI Ergonomics Improvement Plan
nodes.rationale: Five phases (keybinding swap, copy/paste, Ollama-in-TUI polish, Auto Mode, slash commands) split into independently-committable steps; a post-implementation high-effort review found and fixed 10 issues including a Ctrl+Shift+Enter regression and a terminal-state leak on startup failure.

nodes.label: Kitty Keyboard Protocol Handling
nodes.rationale: Legacy terminals emit the same raw byte (0x0D) for Enter, Ctrl+Enter and Shift+Enter, so Shift+Enter newline requires Kitty protocol detection with an Alt+Enter fallback; the same ambiguity means Ctrl+M and Ctrl+I bindings are non-functional in legacy terminals — which is why Ctrl+O was chosen for Model Info instead of Ctrl+M.

nodes.label: Slash-Command Interception Layer
nodes.rationale: App::try_handle_slash_command runs on submit before send_message; unrecognized /... input falls through to the LLM as a normal message so legitimate slash-prefixed content (e.g. paths) is never swallowed; also fixed the bug where [[mcp.servers]] config was parsed but never connected.

nodes.label: tui-textarea Input Migration
nodes.rationale: Replaced the append-only String input buffer; uses input_without_shortcuts() because TextArea's built-in Emacs keymap Ctrl+letter bindings collide with crustly's global shortcuts; ratatui pinned to 0.26.3 in the committed lockfile to avoid two incompatible copies of the Widget trait.

nodes.label: Clipboard Copy/Paste Integration (arboard)
nodes.rationale: Ctrl+Y is one smart keybinding: copies the last fenced code block's raw content if present (via pulldown_cmark, not hand-rolled fence matching), otherwise the full response; Ctrl+V is the explicit paste fallback; both fail gracefully into error_message — arboard fails in ~3ms headless so no timeout wrapper needed.

nodes.label: Model Info Panel (Ctrl+O)
nodes.rationale: Shows provider, model, context window, and last-response PerfMetrics; keep_alive display deferred because it's a private field on OllamaProvider behind Arc<dyn Provider>; 3.2 revealed a real bug — the streaming path discarded final_perf so the panel would always read None until PerfMetrics was threaded through StreamEvent::MessageDelta.

nodes.label: Provider Switch Dialog (Ctrl+W)
nodes.rationale: Scoped to locally-installed Ollama models because App has no Config access and cloud API keys live in Config; a genuine AgentService::set_provider mutator was added because naively rebuilding AgentService would silently drop the tool registry, approval callback, compaction pool, and tool-result cache.
